       peak spectral period Tp) excite vertical water column oscillations inside the captive pneumatic chamber.
       The instantaneous water column surface displacement z_w(t) acts as a virtual reciprocating marine piston,
       compressing and rarefying the chamber headspace volume V_c(t):
           V_c(t) = V_c0 - A_owc * z_w(t)

           dp_c/dt = (gamma * (p_atm + p_c) / V_c) * [ A_owc * dz_w/dt - Q_turbine - Q_bypass ]
       where:
           p_atm      = Atmospheric ambient barometric pressure [1013.25 mbar standard sea level],
           A_owc      = Cross-sectional water plane footprint area [m2],
           Q_turbine  = Bidirectional volumetric airflow exhausted/ingested across Wells turbine rotor [m3/s],

    2. SELF-RECTIFYING WELLS TURBINE AERO-THERMODYNAMICS & STALL COLLAPSE PHENOMENA:
       The Wells turbine, conceived by Dr. Alan Wells, utilizes non-cambered symmetrical NACA 0015 airfoil blades
       oriented at a 90-degree stagger angle relative to the rotational axis (zero chord pitch angle in rotor plane).
       Because the airfoil possesses zero camber and bilateral profile symmetry:
           - Exhalation stroke (+v_ax, air rushing from OWC chamber to atmosphere) creates positive relative velocity W,
             generating aerodynamic lift L and drag D whose resultant tangential force F_tangential drives the rotor forward.
           - Inhalation stroke (-v_ax, air rushing from atmosphere into OWC chamber) inverts the sign of lift and drag,
             producing an identical positive tangential driving torque vector in the EXACT SAME rotational direction:
                 F_tangential = L * sin(alpha) - D * cos(alpha) > 0
       The non-dimensional blade flow coefficient phi is defined as the ratio of axial duct velocity to blade peripheral speed:
           phi = |v_ax| / U_mean = |v_ax| / (omega * r_mean)
       where:
           alpha = arctan(phi) = Aerodynamic effective angle of attack at mean blade radius [rad],
           omega = Rotor angular rotational velocity [rad/s] = (2 * pi * N_rpm) / 60.0.

       CRITICAL STALL COLLAPSE MECHANISM:
       For typical thick NACA profiles, boundary-layer detachment occurs when the flow coefficient exceeds the critical
       aerodynamic stall limit:
           phi > phi_stall_crit (approx. 0.280 .. 0.300, corresponding to alpha_stall approx. 14.5 .. 15.8 deg).
       Upon boundary layer separation:
           a) Rotor aerodynamic driving torque drops abruptly by up to 70-80% (aerodynamic stall cliff),
           b) Pneumatic impedance of the turbine increases sharply, spiking OWC chamber internal pressure p_c,
           c) Intense cyclically fluctuating pressure pulses induce destructive aero-elastic blade flutter,

    3. MULTIVARIABLE DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC):

           x[k+1] = A_d * x[k] + B_d * u[k] + E_d * d[k]

           J = SUM_j=1..Np [ (phi[k+j] - phi_target)^2 * Q_phi + (p_c[k+j])^2 * Q_press + (omega[k+j] - omega_opt)^2 * Q_spd ]
               + SUM_j=0..Nu-1 [ (Delta_T_gen[k+j])^2 * R_tau + (Theta_byp[k+j])^2 * R_byp ]
       Subject to hard constraints:
           phi[k+j] <= 0.260 (Safety stall margin below 0.285 critical cliff)
           0.0 <= Theta_byp <= 90.0 deg
           0.0 <= T_gen_cmd <= T_gen_max [kNm]

    4. TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) VOTING & FAULT TOLERANCE:
       Marine installations suffer from severe bio-fouling, saline aerosol deposition, and sea-spray salt crusting.
       Triple redundant physical instrumentation is deployed:

           - FT_01, FT_02, FT_03: Bi-directional ultrasonic / multi-point differential pitot duct flowmeters.

       The voting core implements median-select 2oo3 logic with inter-channel discrepancy detection.

    5. ISA-88 STATE MACHINE & ISA-18.2 COMPREHENSIVE ALARM ENGINE:
       Automates system lifecycle across 9 deterministic operating states:

    (* --- Aerodynamic Non-Dimensional Observers & Stall Precursors --- *)

    bPT02_Valid                     : BOOL := TRUE;
    bPT03_Valid                     : BOOL := TRUE;

    rDeltaPT12                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rDeltaPT23                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rDeltaPT31                      : REAL := 0.0;

    bFT01_Valid                     : BOOL := TRUE;
    bFT02_Valid                     : BOOL := TRUE;

    iHealthy_FT_Count               : INT  := 3;
    rDeltaFT12                      : REAL := 0.0;

    bST02_Valid                     : BOOL := TRUE;
    bST03_Valid                     : BOOL := TRUE;

    rDeltaST23                      : REAL := 0.0;
    rDeltaST31                      : REAL := 0.0;

    tST_DivergenceTimer             : TON;

    (* Plant States x: [Delta_p_c (mbar), Delta_omega (rpm), phi (-)]^T

    rRotorRadius_Hub_m              : REAL := 1.150;    (* Rotor hub radius [m] *)

    bTrip_BearingOvertemp           : BOOL := FALSE;

(*

  LAYER 1: SENSOR INGESTION & TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) VOTING ENGINE
========================================================================================================================

(* --- 1.1 OWC Air Chamber Differential Pressure Transducers (PT_01, PT_02, PT_03) --- *)
(* Plausibility range check: -150.0 mbar to +150.0 mbar *)
bPT01_Valid := (rChamberPressure_PT01 >= -150.0) AND (rChamberPressure_PT01 <= 150.0);
bPT02_Valid := (rChamberPressure_PT02 >= -150.0) AND (rChamberPressure_PT02 <= 150.0);
bPT03_Valid := (rChamberPressure_PT03 >= -150.0) AND (rChamberPressure_PT03 <= 150.0);

(* Inter-channel delta computation *)
rDeltaPT12 := ABS(rChamberPressure_PT01 - rChamberPressure_PT02);
rDeltaPT23 := ABS(rChamberPressure_PT02 - rChamberPressure_PT03);
rDeltaPT31 := ABS(rChamberPressure_PT03 - rChamberPressure_PT01);

(* Check divergence timer *)
tPT_DivergenceTimer(
    IN := ((rDeltaPT12 > rPT_ToleranceLimit_mbar) OR (rDeltaPT23 > rPT_ToleranceLimit_mbar) OR (rDeltaPT31 > rPT_ToleranceLimit_mbar)),
    PT := T#150MS
);

(* Channel isolation upon sustained discrepancy *)
IF tPT_DivergenceTimer.Q THEN
    IF (rDeltaPT12 > rPT_ToleranceLimit_mbar) AND (rDeltaPT31 > rPT_ToleranceLimit_mbar) THEN
        bPT01_Valid := FALSE; (* PT01 isolated *)
    ELSIF (rDeltaPT12 > rPT_ToleranceLimit_mbar) AND (rDeltaPT23 > rPT_ToleranceLimit_mbar) THEN
        bPT02_Valid := FALSE; (* PT02 isolated *)
    ELSIF (rDeltaPT23 > rPT_ToleranceLimit_mbar) AND (rDeltaPT31 > rPT_ToleranceLimit_mbar) THEN
        bPT03_Valid := FALSE; (* PT03 isolated *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

iHealthy_PT_Count := BOOL_TO_INT(bPT01_Valid) + BOOL_TO_INT(bPT02_Valid) + BOOL_TO_INT(bPT03_Valid);

(* 2oo3 Voting / Graceful Degradation Resolution *)
IF iHealthy_PT_Count = 3 THEN
    (* Standard Median-Select 2oo3 Logic *)
    IF ((rChamberPressure_PT01 >= rChamberPressure_PT02) AND (rChamberPressure_PT01 <= rChamberPressure_PT03)) OR
       ((rChamberPressure_PT01 >= rChamberPressure_PT03) AND (rChamberPressure_PT01 <= rChamberPressure_PT02)) THEN
        rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := rChamberPressure_PT01;
    ELSIF ((rChamberPressure_PT02 >= rChamberPressure_PT01) AND (rChamberPressure_PT02 <= rChamberPressure_PT03)) OR
          ((rChamberPressure_PT02 >= rChamberPressure_PT03) AND (rChamberPressure_PT02 <= rChamberPressure_PT01)) THEN
        rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := rChamberPressure_PT02;
    ELSE
        rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := rChamberPressure_PT03;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthy_PT_Count = 2 THEN
    (* 1oo2 Degraded Mode: Average of two surviving channels *)
    IF bPT01_Valid AND bPT02_Valid THEN
        rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := (rChamberPressure_PT01 + rChamberPressure_PT02) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bPT02_Valid AND bPT03_Valid THEN
        rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := (rChamberPressure_PT02 + rChamberPressure_PT03) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := (rChamberPressure_PT01 + rChamberPressure_PT03) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthy_PT_Count = 1 THEN
    (* 1oo1 Degraded Mode: Sole survivor *)
    IF bPT01_Valid THEN
        rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := rChamberPressure_PT01;
    ELSIF bPT02_Valid THEN
        rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := rChamberPressure_PT02;
    ELSE
        rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := rChamberPressure_PT03;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Collapse *)
    rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar := 0.0;
    bTrip_AllSensorsFailed := TRUE;
END_IF;


(* --- 1.2 Bi-Directional Duct Airflow Velocity Transmitters (FT_01, FT_02, FT_03) --- *)
(* Plausibility range check: -45.0 m/s to +45.0 m/s *)
bFT01_Valid := (rDuctAirVelocity_FT01 >= -45.0) AND (rDuctAirVelocity_FT01 <= 45.0);
bFT02_Valid := (rDuctAirVelocity_FT02 >= -45.0) AND (rDuctAirVelocity_FT02 <= 45.0);
bFT03_Valid := (rDuctAirVelocity_FT03 >= -45.0) AND (rDuctAirVelocity_FT03 <= 45.0);

rDeltaFT12 := ABS(rDuctAirVelocity_FT01 - rDuctAirVelocity_FT02);
rDeltaFT23 := ABS(rDuctAirVelocity_FT02 - rDuctAirVelocity_FT03);
rDeltaFT31 := ABS(rDuctAirVelocity_FT03 - rDuctAirVelocity_FT01);

tFT_DivergenceTimer(
    IN := ((rDeltaFT12 > rFT_ToleranceLimit_ms) OR (rDeltaFT23 > rFT_ToleranceLimit_ms) OR (rDeltaFT31 > rFT_ToleranceLimit_ms)),
    PT := T#150MS
);

IF tFT_DivergenceTimer.Q THEN
    IF (rDeltaFT12 > rFT_ToleranceLimit_ms) AND (rDeltaFT31 > rFT_ToleranceLimit_ms) THEN
        bFT01_Valid := FALSE;
    ELSIF (rDeltaFT12 > rFT_ToleranceLimit_ms) AND (rDeltaFT23 > rFT_ToleranceLimit_ms) THEN
        bFT02_Valid := FALSE;
    ELSIF (rDeltaFT23 > rFT_ToleranceLimit_ms) AND (rDeltaFT31 > rFT_ToleranceLimit_ms) THEN
        bFT03_Valid := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

iHealthy_FT_Count := BOOL_TO_INT(bFT01_Valid) + BOOL_TO_INT(bFT02_Valid) + BOOL_TO_INT(bFT03_Valid);

IF iHealthy_FT_Count = 3 THEN
    IF ((rDuctAirVelocity_FT01 >= rDuctAirVelocity_FT02) AND (rDuctAirVelocity_FT01 <= rDuctAirVelocity_FT03)) OR
       ((rDuctAirVelocity_FT01 >= rDuctAirVelocity_FT03) AND (rDuctAirVelocity_FT01 <= rDuctAirVelocity_FT02)) THEN
        rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := rDuctAirVelocity_FT01;
    ELSIF ((rDuctAirVelocity_FT02 >= rDuctAirVelocity_FT01) AND (rDuctAirVelocity_FT02 <= rDuctAirVelocity_FT03)) OR
          ((rDuctAirVelocity_FT02 >= rDuctAirVelocity_FT03) AND (rDuctAirVelocity_FT02 <= rDuctAirVelocity_FT01)) THEN
        rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := rDuctAirVelocity_FT02;
    ELSE
        rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := rDuctAirVelocity_FT03;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthy_FT_Count = 2 THEN
    IF bFT01_Valid AND bFT02_Valid THEN
        rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := (rDuctAirVelocity_FT01 + rDuctAirVelocity_FT02) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bFT02_Valid AND bFT03_Valid THEN
        rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := (rDuctAirVelocity_FT02 + rDuctAirVelocity_FT03) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := (rDuctAirVelocity_FT01 + rDuctAirVelocity_FT03) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthy_FT_Count = 1 THEN
    IF bFT01_Valid THEN
        rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := rDuctAirVelocity_FT01;
    ELSIF bFT02_Valid THEN
        rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := rDuctAirVelocity_FT02;
    ELSE
        rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := rDuctAirVelocity_FT03;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rAirVelocity_Voted_ms := 0.0;
    bTrip_AllSensorsFailed := TRUE;
END_IF;


(* --- 1.3 PMSG Rotor Shaft Speed Encoders (ST_01, ST_02, ST_03) --- *)
(* Plausibility range check: 0.0 rpm to 2500.0 rpm *)
bST01_Valid := (rRotorSpeed_ST01 >= 0.0) AND (rRotorSpeed_ST01 <= 2500.0);
bST02_Valid := (rRotorSpeed_ST02 >= 0.0) AND (rRotorSpeed_ST02 <= 2500.0);
bST03_Valid := (rRotorSpeed_ST03 >= 0.0) AND (rRotorSpeed_ST03 <= 2500.0);

rDeltaST12 := ABS(rRotorSpeed_ST01 - rRotorSpeed_ST02);
rDeltaST23 := ABS(rRotorSpeed_ST02 - rRotorSpeed_ST03);
rDeltaST31 := ABS(rRotorSpeed_ST03 - rRotorSpeed_ST01);

tST_DivergenceTimer(
    IN := ((rDeltaST12 > rST_ToleranceLimit_rpm) OR (rDeltaST23 > rST_ToleranceLimit_rpm) OR (rDeltaST31 > rST_ToleranceLimit_rpm)),
    PT := T#150MS
);

IF tST_DivergenceTimer.Q THEN
    IF (rDeltaST12 > rST_ToleranceLimit_rpm) AND (rDeltaST31 > rST_ToleranceLimit_rpm) THEN
        bST01_Valid := FALSE;
    ELSIF (rDeltaST12 > rST_ToleranceLimit_rpm) AND (rDeltaST23 > rST_ToleranceLimit_rpm) THEN
        bST02_Valid := FALSE;
    ELSIF (rDeltaST23 > rST_ToleranceLimit_rpm) AND (rDeltaST31 > rST_ToleranceLimit_rpm) THEN
        bST03_Valid := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

iHealthy_ST_Count := BOOL_TO_INT(bST01_Valid) + BOOL_TO_INT(bST02_Valid) + BOOL_TO_INT(bST03_Valid);

IF iHealthy_ST_Count = 3 THEN
    IF ((rRotorSpeed_ST01 >= rRotorSpeed_ST02) AND (rRotorSpeed_ST01 <= rRotorSpeed_ST03)) OR
       ((rRotorSpeed_ST01 >= rRotorSpeed_ST03) AND (rRotorSpeed_ST01 <= rRotorSpeed_ST02)) THEN
        rRotorSpeed_Voted_rpm := rRotorSpeed_ST01;
    ELSIF ((rRotorSpeed_ST02 >= rRotorSpeed_ST01) AND (rRotorSpeed_ST02 <= rRotorSpeed_ST03)) OR
          ((rRotorSpeed_ST02 >= rRotorSpeed_ST03) AND (rRotorSpeed_ST02 <= rRotorSpeed_ST01)) THEN
        rRotorSpeed_Voted_rpm := rRotorSpeed_ST02;
    ELSE
        rRotorSpeed_Voted_rpm := rRotorSpeed_ST03;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthy_ST_Count = 2 THEN
    IF bST01_Valid AND bST02_Valid THEN
        rRotorSpeed_Voted_rpm := (rRotorSpeed_ST01 + rRotorSpeed_ST02) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bST02_Valid AND bST03_Valid THEN
        rRotorSpeed_Voted_rpm := (rRotorSpeed_ST02 + rRotorSpeed_ST03) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rRotorSpeed_Voted_rpm := (rRotorSpeed_ST01 + rRotorSpeed_ST03) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSIF iHealthy_ST_Count = 1 THEN
    IF bST01_Valid THEN
        rRotorSpeed_Voted_rpm := rRotorSpeed_ST01;
    ELSIF bST02_Valid THEN
        rRotorSpeed_Voted_rpm := rRotorSpeed_ST02;
    ELSE
        rRotorSpeed_Voted_rpm := rRotorSpeed_ST03;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rRotorSpeed_Voted_rpm := 0.0;
    bTrip_AllSensorsFailed := TRUE;
END_IF;

bDegradedSensorMode := (iHealthy_PT_Count < 3) OR (iHealthy_FT_Count < 3) OR (iHealthy_ST_Count < 3);


(*
========================================================================================================================
  LAYER 2: AERODYNAMIC OBSERVERS, STALL ESTIMATION & DERIVATIVE CALCULATORS
========================================================================================================================
*)

(* Convert rotor rotational speed from rpm to angular velocity rad/s *)
rRotorOmega_rad_s := (rRotorSpeed_Voted_rpm * 6.2831853) / 60.0;

(* Peripheral linear velocity at mean aerodynamic blade radius r_mean = 1.450 m *)
IF rRotorOmega_rad_s > 1.0 THEN
    rBladePeripheralSpeed_ms := rRotorOmega_rad_s * rRotorRadius_Mean_m;
ELSE
    rBladePeripheralSpeed_ms := 1.450; (* Numerical floor to prevent divide-by-zero during standstill *)
END_IF;

(* Wells turbine non-dimensional flow coefficient: phi = |v_ax| / (omega * r_mean) *)
rFlowCoefficient_Phi := ABS(rAirVelocity_Voted_ms) / rBladePeripheralSpeed_ms;

(* First-order low pass filter on flow coefficient to reject high-frequency turbulence *)
rFilteredPhi := (0.80 * rFilteredPhi) + (0.20 * rFlowCoefficient_Phi);

(* Rate-of-change (derivative) of flow coefficient: d(phi)/dt with Ts = 0.020 s *)
rPhi_Derivative := (rFilteredPhi - rPreviousPhi) / 0.020;
rPreviousPhi := rFilteredPhi;

(* Angle of attack at mean blade radius: alpha = arctan(phi) in degrees *)
rAngleOfAttack_Alpha_deg := ATAN(rFlowCoefficient_Phi) * 57.29578;

(* Rate of change of chamber differential pressure: d(p_c)/dt *)
rPressure_Derivative := (rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar - rPreviousPressure) / 0.020;
rPreviousPressure := rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar;

(* Stall Precursor Detector: Predictive boundary-layer trip indicator *)
bStallPrecursorAlarm := (rFilteredPhi >= rWarningStallPhi) OR
                        ((rFilteredPhi >= 0.200) AND (rPhi_Derivative > 0.850));

(* Wells turbine aerodynamic pneumatic mechanical power estimation [kW]:
   P_aero = Delta_p_c [Pa] * Q_volumetric [m3/s] * efficiency_factor
   Delta_p_c [Pa] = rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar * 100.0 *)
rEstimatedAeroPower_kW := (ABS(rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar) * 100.0 * (ABS(rAirVelocity_Voted_ms) * rDuctArea_m2) * 0.62) / 1000.0;

(* Net active electrical power estimation delivered by PMSG [kW] *)
rEstimatedElectPower_kW := (rGenActualTorque_kNm * rRotorOmega_rad_s * 0.94);


(*
========================================================================================================================
  LAYER 3: DISCRETE STATE-SPACE PREDICTION & RECEDING HORIZON OPTIMIZER (MPC)
========================================================================================================================
*)

(* Populate current plant state vector x[k] *)
aState_X[0] := rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar;
aState_X[1] := rRotorSpeed_Voted_rpm - rRatedSpeed_rpm;
aState_X[2] := rFilteredPhi;

(* Execute Receding Horizon Grid Search Optimization (Prediction Horizon Np=2, Control Horizon Nu=1) *)
rCost_Best := 1.0E9;
rBest_Torque_Candidate := 0.0;
rBest_Bypass_Candidate := 0.0;

(* If autonomous MPC mode selected and system is in normal or stall regulation state *)
IF bAutoModeSelect AND ((iState = 30) OR (iState = 40)) THEN

    (* Evaluate discrete control search grid across torque (5 intervals) and bypass valve (5 intervals) *)
    FOR iLoop_T := 0 TO 4 DO
        rCand_T := INT_TO_REAL(iLoop_T) * 10.0; (* 0.0 to 40.0 kNm *)

        FOR iLoop_B := 0 TO 4 DO
            rCand_B := INT_TO_REAL(iLoop_B) * 22.5; (* 0.0, 22.5, 45.0, 67.5, 90.0 deg *)

            (* --- Horizon Step k+1 State Projection: x[k+1] = A*x[k] + B*u[k] + E*d[k] --- *)
            aState_X_Pred1[0] := (aA_Matrix[0,0] * aState_X[0]) + (aA_Matrix[0,1] * aState_X[1]) + (aA_Matrix[0,2] * aState_X[2])
                               + (aB_Matrix[0,0] * rCand_T)     + (aB_Matrix[0,1] * rCand_B)     + (aE_Disturb[0] * rAirVelocity_Voted_ms);

            aState_X_Pred1[1] := (aA_Matrix[1,0] * aState_X[0]) + (aA_Matrix[1,1] * aState_X[1]) + (aA_Matrix[1,2] * aState_X[2])
                               + (aB_Matrix[1,0] * rCand_T)     + (aB_Matrix[1,1] * rCand_B)     + (aE_Disturb[1] * rAirVelocity_Voted_ms);

            aState_X_Pred1[2] := (aA_Matrix[2,0] * aState_X[0]) + (aA_Matrix[2,1] * aState_X[1]) + (aA_Matrix[2,2] * aState_X[2])
                               + (aB_Matrix[2,0] * rCand_T)     + (aB_Matrix[2,1] * rCand_B)     + (aE_Disturb[2] * rSignificantWaveHeight_Hs);

            (* --- Horizon Step k+2 State Projection: x[k+2] = A*x[k+1] + B*u[k] --- *)
            aState_X_Pred2[0] := (aA_Matrix[0,0] * aState_X_Pred1[0]) + (aA_Matrix[0,1] * aState_X_Pred1[1]) + (aA_Matrix[0,2] * aState_X_Pred1[2])
                               + (aB_Matrix[0,0] * rCand_T)          + (aB_Matrix[0,1] * rCand_B);

            aState_X_Pred2[1] := (aA_Matrix[1,0] * aState_X_Pred1[0]) + (aA_Matrix[1,1] * aState_X_Pred1[1]) + (aA_Matrix[1,2] * aState_X_Pred1[2])
                               + (aB_Matrix[1,0] * rCand_T)          + (aB_Matrix[1,1] * rCand_B);

            aState_X_Pred2[2] := (aA_Matrix[2,0] * aState_X_Pred1[0]) + (aA_Matrix[2,1] * aState_X_Pred1[1]) + (aA_Matrix[2,2] * aState_X_Pred1[2])
                               + (aB_Matrix[2,0] * rCand_T)          + (aB_Matrix[2,1] * rCand_B);

            (* Quadratic Stage Cost Evaluation *)
            rCost_Candidate := (EXPT(aState_X_Pred1[2], 2) * rWeight_Q_Phi)
                             + (EXPT(aState_X_Pred1[0], 2) * rWeight_Q_Press)
                             + (EXPT(aState_X_Pred1[1], 2) * rWeight_Q_Speed)
                             + (EXPT(aState_X_Pred2[2], 2) * rWeight_Q_Phi * 1.5)
                             + (EXPT(rCand_T - rGenActualTorque_kNm, 2) * rWeight_R_Torque)
                             + (EXPT(rCand_B, 2) * rWeight_R_Bypass);

            (* Severe Barrier Penalty on Aerodynamic Stall Incursion *)
            IF (aState_X_Pred1[2] > rCriticalStallPhi) OR (aState_X_Pred2[2] > rCriticalStallPhi) THEN
                rCost_Candidate := rCost_Candidate + 1.0E6;
            ELSIF (aState_X_Pred1[2] > rWarningStallPhi) THEN
                rCost_Candidate := rCost_Candidate + 5.0E4;
            END_IF;

            (* Retain Minimizing Control Pair *)
            IF rCost_Candidate < rCost_Best THEN
                rCost_Best := rCost_Candidate;
                rBest_Torque_Candidate := rCand_T;
                rBest_Bypass_Candidate := rCand_B;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    rMpcTorqueCommand := rBest_Torque_Candidate;
    rMpcBypassCommand := rBest_Bypass_Candidate;

    (* Stator guide vane dynamic angle: modulated inversely with flow coefficient to smooth angle of attack *)
    rMpcGuideVaneCommand := LIMIT(0.0, (rFilteredPhi / rCriticalStallPhi) * 35.0, 45.0);

ELSE
    (* Fallback / Deterministic Manual baseline *)
    rMpcTorqueCommand := 15.0;
    rMpcBypassCommand := 0.0;
    rMpcGuideVaneCommand := 0.0;
END_IF;


(*
========================================================================================================================
  LAYER 4: SEQUENTIAL FINITE STATE MACHINE (ISA-88 MODULAR PROCEDURAL STATES)
========================================================================================================================
*)

tStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPreviousState), PT := T#24H);
iPreviousState := iState;

(* Debounce timers for special conditions *)
tWaterSlugTimer(IN := bWaterSlugDetected, PT := T#80MS);
tStallSheddingTimer(IN := (iState = 40), PT := T#6S);
tDecelTimeoutTimer(IN := (iState = 90), PT := T#45S);

CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE_BOOT_DIAGNOSTICS: Cold hardware interlock and self-test *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemActive := FALSE;
        bMechanicalBrakeEngage := TRUE; (* Clamp caliper brake during boot *)
        rGenTorqueDemand_kNm := 0.0;
        rBypassValveDemand_deg := 90.0; (* Full bypass vent to relieve static hydraulic surging *)
        rGuideVaneDemand_deg := 0.0;

        IF bEmergencyStopOk AND bMasterEnable AND (NOT bTrip_AllSensorsFailed) THEN
            IF tStateTimer.ET >= T#2S THEN
                iState := 10; (* Transition to Standby *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_STANDBY_EQUILIBRIUM: Quiescent sea state, waiting for threshold swell *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemActive := FALSE;
        bMechanicalBrakeEngage := FALSE; (* Release caliper brake; shaft resting on magnetic detent *)
        rGenTorqueDemand_kNm := 0.0;
        rBypassValveDemand_deg := 0.0;   (* Seal chamber to allow hydrostatic wave oscillation *)
        rGuideVaneDemand_deg := 0.0;

        (* Check for wave excitation sufficient for spin-up *)
        IF (rSignificantWaveHeight_Hs >= 0.85) AND (ABS(rAirVelocity_Voted_ms) >= 3.5) THEN
            iState := 20; (* Proceed to aerodynamic pre-synchronization *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_PRE_SYNC_ACCELERATION: Aerodynamic self-start and motoring assistance *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemActive := FALSE;
        bMechanicalBrakeEngage := FALSE;
        rBypassValveDemand_deg := 0.0;
        rGuideVaneDemand_deg := 15.0; (* Direct airflow onto NACA blades *)

        (* If rotor speed is below self-sustaining threshold, provide soft motoring torque *)
        IF rRotorSpeed_Voted_rpm < rMinOperatingSpeed_rpm THEN
            rGenTorqueDemand_kNm := -4.5; (* Negative torque = motoring mode to accelerate rotor *)
        ELSE
            rGenTorqueDemand_kNm := 0.0;
            iState := 30; (* Rotor at operational speed; engage active power extraction *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_OPTIMAL_BIDIRECTIONAL_MPPT: Closed-loop wave power extraction *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemActive := TRUE;
        bMechanicalBrakeEngage := FALSE;

        (* Assign MPC-optimized trajectory outputs *)
        rGenTorqueDemand_kNm := rMpcTorqueCommand;
        rBypassValveDemand_deg := rMpcBypassCommand;
        rGuideVaneDemand_deg := rMpcGuideVaneCommand;

        (* Evaluate Stall Trigger: Early precursor or flow coefficient exceedance *)
        IF bStallPrecursorAlarm OR (rFilteredPhi >= rCriticalStallPhi) THEN
            iState := 40; (* Divert immediately to stall regulation shedding *)
        (* Severe storm wave swell: Protect chamber structure *)
        ELSIF (rSignificantWaveHeight_Hs >= 6.5) OR (ABS(rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar) >= 95.0) THEN
            iState := 50; (* Extreme storm depressurization *)
        (* Sea swell subsided: Return to standby *)
        ELSIF (rRotorSpeed_Voted_rpm < (rMinOperatingSpeed_rpm - 50.0)) AND (rSignificantWaveHeight_Hs < 0.60) THEN
            iState := 10;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_PROACTIVE_AERODYNAMIC_STALL_SHEDDING: High-speed bypass air shedding *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemActive := TRUE;
        bMechanicalBrakeEngage := FALSE;

        (* Fast bypass opening: Slew valve open to dump peak axial velocity surge *)
        rBypassValveDemand_deg := 75.0;

        (* Counter-torque modification: Soften generator torque slightly to let rotor accelerate,
           increasing blade peripheral velocity U_mean, thereby driving phi = v_ax / U_mean back down! *)
        rGenTorqueDemand_kNm := LIMIT(5.0, rGenActualTorque_kNm * 0.65, 25.0);
        rGuideVaneDemand_deg := 0.0;

        (* Exit stall shedding when flow coefficient drops back below safe margin *)
        IF (rFilteredPhi <= 0.210) AND (tStallSheddingTimer.ET >= T#800MS) THEN
            iState := 30; (* Return to optimal MPPT *)
        ELSIF tStallSheddingTimer.Q THEN
            (* Stall persistence exceeded: Force transition back or escalate *)
            iState := 30;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_EXTREME_SEA_STORM_DEPRESSURIZATION: Survival mode in 100-year storm seas *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemActive := FALSE;
        bMechanicalBrakeEngage := FALSE;
        rBypassValveDemand_deg := 90.0; (* Lock bypass 100% open to completely depressurize chamber *)
        rGuideVaneDemand_deg := 0.0;
        rGenTorqueDemand_kNm := 12.0;   (* Moderate electrical braking to prevent rotor overspeed *)

        IF (rSignificantWaveHeight_Hs < 5.0) AND (ABS(rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar) < 60.0) THEN
            iState := 20; (* Recover to pre-sync acceleration *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_WATER_SLUG_CREST_INTERCEPT: Internal column crest defense against green water *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemActive := FALSE;
        bMechanicalBrakeEngage := FALSE;
        rBypassValveDemand_deg := 90.0; (* Full vent to vent slamming shockwave *)
        rGenTorqueDemand_kNm := 0.0;
        rGuideVaneDemand_deg := 0.0;

        IF (NOT bWaterSlugDetected) AND (tStateTimer.ET >= T#5S) THEN
            iState := 10; (* Return to standby after water column recedes *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE_CONTROLLED_REGENERATIVE_DECELERATION: Controlled electric spin-down *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemActive := FALSE;
        bMechanicalBrakeEngage := FALSE;
        rBypassValveDemand_deg := 90.0;
        rGuideVaneDemand_deg := 0.0;

        (* Apply regenerative braking torque to halt drivetrain smoothly *)
        rGenTorqueDemand_kNm := LIMIT(0.0, (rRotorSpeed_Voted_rpm / 100.0) * 8.0, rMaxGenTorque_kNm);

        IF (rRotorSpeed_Voted_rpm <= 40.0) OR tDecelTimeoutTimer.Q THEN
            bMechanicalBrakeEngage := TRUE; (* Lock mechanical caliper brake *)
            iState := 0; (* Return to cold boot / parked *)
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE_EMERGENCY_FAILSAFE_SHUTDOWN_LATCH: Immediate safety trip clamp *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemActive := FALSE;
        bMechanicalBrakeEngage := TRUE;  (* Clamp spring-applied hydraulic caliper disc brake *)
        rGenTorqueDemand_kNm := 0.0;     (* Decouple electrical converter *)
        rBypassValveDemand_deg := 90.0;  (* Dump all pneumatic pressure *)
        rGuideVaneDemand_deg := 0.0;

        (* Latch can only be reset if all trips cleared and master enable cycled *)
        IF bEmergencyStopOk AND (NOT bTrip_Overspeed) AND (NOT bTrip_ChamberOverpress) AND
           (NOT bTrip_WaterSlug) AND (NOT bTrip_BearingOvertemp) AND (NOT bTrip_AllSensorsFailed) THEN
            IF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
                iState := 0; (* Reset to cold boot *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;


(*
========================================================================================================================
  LAYER 5: ISA-18.2 COMPREHENSIVE ALARM ENGINE & STATUS WORD REGISTERS
========================================================================================================================
*)

(* Trip Condition Monitoring *)
bTrip_EStop            := NOT bEmergencyStopOk;
bTrip_Overspeed        := (rRotorSpeed_Voted_rpm >= rMaxAllowableSpeed_rpm);
bTrip_ChamberOverpress := (ABS(rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar) >= rMaxChamberPressure_mbar);
bTrip_WaterSlug        := tWaterSlugTimer.Q;
bTrip_BearingOvertemp  := (rTurbineBearingTemp_degC >= 95.0);

(* Critical Trip Intervention *)
IF bTrip_EStop OR bTrip_Overspeed OR bTrip_ChamberOverpress OR
   bTrip_WaterSlug OR bTrip_BearingOvertemp OR bTrip_AllSensorsFailed THEN
    iState := 99; (* Trip directly into emergency failsafe latch *)
END_IF;

(* Pack ISA-18.2 Priority 1 Alarm Register (Shutdown Trips) *)
wAlarmWord_Priority1.0 := bTrip_EStop;
wAlarmWord_Priority1.1 := bTrip_Overspeed;
wAlarmWord_Priority1.2 := bTrip_ChamberOverpress;
wAlarmWord_Priority1.3 := bTrip_WaterSlug;
wAlarmWord_Priority1.4 := bTrip_BearingOvertemp;
wAlarmWord_Priority1.5 := bTrip_AllSensorsFailed;
wAlarmWord_Priority1.6 := (rRotorSpeed_Voted_rpm >= (rMaxAllowableSpeed_rpm - 50.0));
wAlarmWord_Priority1.7 := (ABS(rChamberPressure_Voted_mbar) >= (rMaxChamberPressure_mbar - 10.0));
wAlarmWord_Priority1.8 := (iState = 99);

(* Pack ISA-18.2 Priority 2 Alarm Register (Operational Warnings & Degraded Sensors) *)
wAlarmWord_Priority2.0 := bStallPrecursorAlarm;
wAlarmWord_Priority2.1 := (rFilteredPhi >= rCriticalStallPhi);
wAlarmWord_Priority2.2 := NOT bPT01_Valid;
wAlarmWord_Priority2.3 := NOT bPT02_Valid;
wAlarmWord_Priority2.4 := NOT bPT03_Valid;
wAlarmWord_Priority2.5 := NOT bFT01_Valid;
wAlarmWord_Priority2.6 := NOT bFT02_Valid;
wAlarmWord_Priority2.7 := NOT bFT03_Valid;
wAlarmWord_Priority2.8 := NOT bST01_Valid;
wAlarmWord_Priority2.9 := NOT bST02_Valid;
wAlarmWord_Priority2.10 := NOT bST03_Valid;
wAlarmWord_Priority2.11 := bDegradedSensorMode;
wAlarmWord_Priority2.12 := bGridFaultRideThroughActive;
wAlarmWord_Priority2.13 := (rTurbineBearingTemp_degC >= 80.0);

(* Pack ISA-88 Diagnostic Status Word *)
wSystemStatusWord.0 := bSystemReady;
wSystemStatusWord.1 := bSystemActive;
wSystemStatusWord.2 := bAutoModeSelect;
wSystemStatusWord.3 := bDegradedSensorMode;
wSystemStatusWord.4 := bMechanicalBrakeEngage;
wSystemStatusWord.5 := (iState = 30); (* Active MPPT Generation *)
wSystemStatusWord.6 := (iState = 40); (* Active Stall Regulation *)
wSystemStatusWord.7 := (iState = 50); (* Storm Depressurization *)
wSystemStatusWord.8 := (iState = 60); (* Water Slug Intercept *)
wSystemStatusWord.9 := (iState = 99); (* Emergency Shutdown *)


(*
========================================================================================================================
  LAYER 6: FINAL ACTUATOR CLAMPING, SLEW-RATE LIMITING & FAIL-SAFE INTERLOCKS
========================================================================================================================
*)

(* Enforce hard limits and slew-rate safety margins *)
rGenTorqueDemand_kNm   := LIMIT(0.0, rGenTorqueDemand_kNm, rMaxGenTorque_kNm);
rBypassValveDemand_deg := LIMIT(0.0, rBypassValveDemand_deg, 90.0);
rGuideVaneDemand_deg   := LIMIT(0.0, rGuideVaneDemand_deg, 45.0);

(* If Emergency Stop is active or Mechanical Brake is engaged, zero electrical torque setpoint *)
IF (NOT bEmergencyStopOk) OR bMechanicalBrakeEngage THEN
    rGenTorqueDemand_kNm := 0.0;
END_IF;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
